summary: M495 — Save-game now shows a gold confirmation pop (was a near-invisible grey line). Hiring/recruiting with Auto Passives + Auto Spell Talents both on now skips the empty Skills step and confirms directly. giant_spider + 6 inline-encounter bosses (the_unraveler/dragon_king/vault_guardian/void_scholar/echo_sovereign/the_first_ember) added to the appearances manifest so the GAME and images.html read the same source (giant_spider now shows its openai_v2 sprite, not the stale axe one). Recruit builder: class-choice step, no soft-lock on cancel, gold/brown theming via extracted shared cb-styles module. Dialog text no longer rendered behind character sprites.
